reviewScope: Independent design-contract review only. This review does not mark DR-103 SATISFIED, does not qualify or demonstrate anything, and does not authorize implementation.
summary: The named v6 repairs are substantively coherent, and the two carried Claude advisories are honestly not claimed repaired. However, v7 violates its own exact-delta method: three source-measurement paths changed outside every repairLog operation, including the entirely new reMeasurementAtV7 empirical claim.

blockers.title: Three v6-to-v7 source paths changed outside the v7 repairLog
blockers.detail: basedOn.method makes an exact assertion that every path not named by one of the six v7 repairLog entries is unchanged from v6. The recursive comparison refutes it. /sources/reMeasurementAtV2 and /sources/reMeasurementAtV5 were both edited to replace corpusHeadAtAuthoring with corpusHeadAtV2Authoring, but CLAUDE-V6-A5 names only the field rename at /sources/corpusHeadAtAuthoring; it does not name either scalar reference path. More decisively, /sources/reMeasurementAtV7 is a wholly new empirical custody claim and no repair entry or META-v7 operation names it. The three values are accurate, but accuracy does not repair the false closed-delta assertion. The repairLog is the subject's declared audit boundary, so an unlogged source claim prevents independent acceptance of the lineage.
blockers.requiredRepair: In a successor, account explicitly for all three source paths and make the basedOn completeness claim match the actual predecessor delta. Treat reMeasurementAtV7 as authoring metadata with its own named ADD operation; name both historical reference updates rather than relying on the corpus-head field rename to imply them.

attackListDisposition.detail: whatThisDoesNotDo now says only that v7 authors no fixtures and that a separate candidate may exist but is not accepted, qualified, applied, or DR-103-satisfying. The candidate does exist; its digest and all 64 declared paths reproduced, so the modal statement is not false and carries no authorization.
The six-id roster exactly matches repairLog[44:50] and contains no future-fold hedge. V7-B1 is a separate failure of the same sentence's assertion that every unnamed path stayed unchanged.
The comparison found 29 minimal changed paths. Three source paths are not named by any repair operation: reMeasurementAtV2, reMeasurementAtV5, and the added reMeasurementAtV7.
The header remains CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED / AWAITING-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW / DO-NOT-SEAL / binds NOTHING, authorityClaim is NONE, and all fixture language is explicitly non-authorizing.
